prohibitions.noBackfill: No historical depth, price, business or valuation data was backfilled. Every number in this report is read from the store as it stands; a missing value is reported as missing and never replaced by a default zero or an estimate.
prohibitions.noHandEdit: No admission, library version, scope pin, pool row or Manager row was edited by hand. The store was opened read-only.
prohibitions.noApply: No rebuild, no re-materialisation and no --apply of any kind was performed.
prohibitions.noBroadcast: No transaction was sent and no broadcast was attempted. The chain config itself declares allow_official_v4_broadcast=False.
prohibitions.measuredVsUnmeasured: A measured zero and an unmeasured quantity are kept apart: the websocket stream is reported as unavailable because the chain config declares no endpoint, which is not the same as a measured absence of traffic.
